title: Payload Schema
description: Describes a Payload Schema that may be used to validate a Track Event's `payload`

external_id.description: A string identifier used to identify the Payload Schema in other systems. If the Payload Schema is imported from another system and has a URI, or other identifier, it should be set here.

label.description: Freeform string label for the Payload Schema. This should be a very short, human-readable label that may be displayed in listings of Payload Schemas.

description.description: Freeform text describing the Payload Schema. This should be a human-readable description that may be displayed in detailed views of Payload Schemas. The description should be longer and more detailed than `label`.

created_by.description: A string identifier for the entity that created the Payload Schema. Service Implementations SHOULD set suitable default values for `created_by` based on the principal accessing the systems.

updated_by.description: A string identifier for the entity that updated the Payload Schema metadata most recently. Service Implementations SHOULD set suitable default values for `updated_by` based on the principal accessing the system.

created.description: The date-time the Payload Schema was created in a given context, e.g. in the Service Instance. Service Implementations SHOULD ignore this if given in a PUT request, and instead manage it internally

updated.description: The date-time the Payload Schema metadata was last updated in a given context, e.g. in the Service Instance. Service Implementations SHOULD ignore this if given in a PUT request, and instead manage it internally

schema.description: The schema itself. Conforms to the JSON schema specification. Service Implementations must not permit editing of the `schema` itself.
